cd /code && Rscript - <<'RS'
library(tidyverse); library(WebPower)
dMRIreg <- read.csv('/data/fMRInf_regulation.csv'); dMRIbeh <- read.csv('/data/fMRInf_behaviour.csv')
output <- function(d){for (i in 1:nrow(d)){if (d$test[i]=='anova'){d$small[i] <- wp.rmanova(d$n[i], d$ng[i], d$nm[i], f=0.1, nscor=1, alpha=0.05, power=NULL, type=d$type[i])$power; d$medium[i] <- wp.rmanova(d$n[i], d$ng[i], d$nm[i], f=0.25, nscor=1, alpha=0.05, power=NULL, type=d$type[i])$power; d$large[i] <- wp.rmanova(d$n[i], d$ng[i], d$nm[i], f=0.4, nscor=1, alpha=0.05, power=NULL, type=d$type[i])$power; d$p80[i] <- wp.rmanova(d$n[i], d$ng[i], d$nm[i], f=NULL, nscor=1, alpha=0.05, power=.80, type=d$type[i])$f*2; d$p95[i] <- wp.rmanova(d$n[i], d$ng[i], d$nm[i], f=NULL, nscor=1, alpha=0.05, power=.95, type=d$type[i])$f*2} else if (d$test[i]=='ttest2'){d$small[i] <- wp.t(n1=floor(d$n[i]/2), n2=ceiling(d$n[i]/2), d=.2, alpha=0.05, power=NULL, type=d$type[i], alternative=d$tails[i])$power; d$medium[i] <- wp.t(n1=floor(d$n[i]/2), n2=ceiling(d$n[i]/2), d=.5, alpha=0.05, power=NULL, type=d$type[i], alternative=d$tails[i])$power; d$large[i] <- wp.t(n1=floor(d$n[i]/2), n2=ceiling(d$n[i]/2), d=.8, alpha=0.05, power=NULL, type=d$type[i], alternative=d$tails[i])$power; d$p80[i] <- wp.t(n1=floor(d$n[i]/2), n2=ceiling(d$n[i]/2), d=NULL, alpha=0.05, power=.80, type=d$type[i], alternative=d$tails[i])$d; d$p95[i] <- wp.t(n1=floor(d$n[i]/2), n2=ceiling(d$n[i]/2), d=NULL, alpha=0.05, power=.95, type=d$type[i], alternative=d$tails[i])$d} else if (d$test[i]=='ttest1'){d$small[i] <- wp.t(n1=d$n[i], n2=NULL, d=.2, alpha=0.05, power=NULL, type=d$type[i], alternative=d$tails[i])$power; d$medium[i] <- wp.t(n1=d$n[i], n2=NULL, d=.5, alpha=0.05, power=NULL, type=d$type[i], alternative=d$tails[i])$power; d$large[i] <- wp.t(n1=d$n[i], n2=NULL, d=.8, alpha=0.05, power=NULL, type=d$type[i], alternative=d$tails[i])$power; d$p80[i] <- wp.t(n1=d$n[i], n2=NULL, d=NULL, alpha=0.05, power=.80, type=d$type[i], alternative=d$tails[i])$d; d$p95[i] <- wp.t(n1=d$n[i], n2=NULL, d=NULL, alpha=0.05, power=.95, type=d$type[i], alternative=d$tails[i])$d} else if (d$test[i]=='corr'){d$small[i] <- wp.correlation(n=d$n[i], r=0.1, power=NULL, alpha=0.05, alternative=d$tails[i])$power; d$medium[i] <- wp.correlation(n=d$n[i], r=0.243, power=NULL, alpha=0.05, alternative=d$tails[i])$power; d$large[i] <- wp.correlation(n=d$n[i], r=0.371, power=NULL, alpha=0.05, alternative=d$tails[i])$power; r <- wp.correlation(n=d$n[i], r=NULL, power=.80, alpha=0.05, alternative=d$tails[i])$r; d$p80[i] <- 2*r/sqrt(1-r^2); r <- wp.correlation(n=d$n[i], r=NULL, power=.95, alpha=0.05, alternative=d$tails[i])$r; d$p95[i] <- 2*r/sqrt(1-r^2)} else if (d$test[i]=='regression'){d$small[i] <- wp.regression(n=d$n[i], p1=1, f2=0.1^2, power=NULL, alpha=0.05)$power; d$medium[i] <- wp.regression(n=d$n[i], p1=1, f2=0.25^2, power=NULL, alpha=0.05)$power; d$large[i] <- wp.regression(n=d$n[i], p1=1, f2=0.4^2, power=NULL, alpha=0.05)$power; f2 <- wp.regression(n=d$n[i], p1=1, f2=NULL, power=.80, alpha=0.05)$f2; d$p80[i] <- sqrt(f2)*2; f2 <- wp.regression(n=d$n[i], p1=1, f2=NULL, power=.95, alpha=0.05)$f2; d$p95[i] <- sqrt(f2)*2}}; d}

dMRIreg <- output(dMRIreg); dMRIbeh <- output(dMRIbeh)
tMRIreg <- dMRIreg %>% filter(pilot=='N') %>% summarize(mean(n), mean(small), mean(medium), mean(large), mean(p80), mean(p95))
print(tMRIreg)
RS
